terminal_receipt_contract.binding_direction: AUDIT_RESULT binds unchanged provisional AUDIT_ATTEMPT and private evidence; final STATUS binds authoritative AUDIT_RESULT. No circular/self hash.

terminal_receipt_contract.asynchronous_input_limit: Final custody is a checked boundary, not a freeze protecting inputs after the check.
